read_proto_data_from_mcap: read proto data including timesteps, actions, and policy extra from mcap files in a given root path
parse_examples_to_dm_env: parse tensorflow example protos into dm_env timestep, action, and policy extra types using specs
get_mcap_file_paths: get sorted mcap file paths from a directory or single mcap file by episode UUID and shard number
read_session_proto_data: read session metadata proto messages from mcap files for a given session topic name
read_and_parse_mcap_messages: read raw mcap messages from files and parse them into a specified protobuf message type
